image-name.description: Producer-supplied memory image name/reference. It is not a path to fetch.

image-sha256.description: Memory image SHA-256 supplied by the producer. Never computed from the results export or verified by opening the image.

layer-name.description: Producer-supplied memory layer name; particularly useful for global YARA scans.

match-data.description: Reported YARA matched bytes as emitted by the JSON renderer; retain the raw row for exact source representation.

memory-end.description: Reported suspicious region End VPN address, as hexadecimal.

memory-protection.description: Reported memory protection string for a suspicious region.

memory-start.description: Reported suspicious region Start VPN address, as hexadecimal; does not assert maliciousness.

network-created.description: Reported network object creation time; this is not a first-packet observation.

network-created-raw.description: Original network Created value before normalization.

offset.description: Reported Offset column, rendered losslessly as hexadecimal. Its address space is plugin/layer-specific and is not inferred.

offset-physical.description: Reported Offset(P) physical address, rendered losslessly as hexadecimal.

offset-virtual.description: Reported Offset(V) virtual address, rendered losslessly as hexadecimal.

parent-process-id.description: Reported PPID. A matching number alone does not establish a parent relationship.

plugin.description: Fully qualified Volatility 3 plugin used to produce this result.

plugin-version.description: Plugin class version, supplied by the producer; distinct from the Volatility framework version.

process-created.description: Normalized process creation time with a known timezone and without precision loss.

process-created-raw.description: Original CreateTime value, including unavailable or unsupported time context where supplied.

process-exited.description: Reported process exit time normalized only when its offset and precision are known.

process-id.description: Reported PID, scoped to the source image/run and row, not a globally unique process identity.

process-name.description: Process name reported by the plugin.

raw-result.description: Normalized JSON of the original row columns. Renderer __children hierarchy is represented by row-path and object references; exact export bytes remain authoritative.

result-index.description: One-based result index in depth-first traversal, including nested rows.

result-kind.description: Mapping category: process, process-tree, command-line, network, suspicious-memory or yara-match.

review-status.description: Analyst review state. Imported plugin observations and matches start as unreviewed, not confirmed malicious.

row-path.description: One-based renderer row path, such as 1.2 for the second child of the first root. This is not a process identifier.

rule-name.description: Name of the matched YARA rule, not the rule body or a confirmed malicious verdict.

source-sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact JSON/JSONL export bytes, not the memory image.

volatility-version.description: Volatility 3 version supplied by the producer; not inferred from output columns.

description: A Volatility 3 result row with memory-image provenance, plugin/version context, offsets and unreviewed memory or YARA observations. Link to source exports and derived process or network-socket objects.
name: volatility3-result
